movelist.name: Tailwind
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

movelist.name: Rain Dance
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Rainy for 5 rounds. While Rainy, Water-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Fire-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

movelist.name: Roost
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. If the user is a Flying Type, it loses the Flying Type until the start of their next turn.

movelist.name: Air Slash
movelist.effect: Air Slash Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

movelist.name: Feather Dance
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Attack lowered 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Big Pecks
abilities.effect: The user cannot have its Defense Stat lowered. The user cannot have its Defense Combat Stages lowered. Defensive.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Hydration’s Frequency is ignored if used during Rainy Weather.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: The user’s Effect Range is increased by +2.
